tiers.name: Flattened RVQ Sequence (8x Sequence Length = 100 Hz on Full 7B Trunk)
tiers.note: Runs the full 7B LLM 8 times per 80ms audio frame (96.0ms > 80.0ms real-time budget -> RTF = 1.20x continuous audio buffer underrun/stutter)!

tiers.name: Single-Step Parallel Independent RVQ Heads (No Intra-Frame Causal Depth Conditioning)
tiers.note: Predicts fine acoustic codebooks c_2..8 without conditioning on sampled semantic/coarse c_1 -> severe metallic artifacts (2.85 MOS)!

tiers.name: Delayed-Pattern RVQ (12.5 Hz Diagonal Shift) + Full-Sentence Non-Causal Vocoder
tiers.note: Keeps 7B trunk at 12.5 Hz via diagonal codebook delay, but waiting for sentence completion before vocoding stalls TTFA at 1,250.0ms.

tiers.name: Hierarchical Dual-AR (12.5Hz 7B Temporal + 100M Depth AR) + 2-Frame Causal Stream Vocoder
tiers.note: Runs 7B trunk once per 80ms frame (12.0ms) + 100M Depth Transformer for 8 RVQ steps in CUDAGraph (1.8ms) + causal streaming codec -> 145ms TTFA & 4.42 MOS!
